scope: headless Chrome WebGPU single-filter prototype; 1280x720 storage-buffer upload, compute dispatch and mapped readback vs CPU Procamp pixel loop

separateFullSuiteObservation.note: Earlier test before varied-parameter correctness loops, run after other GPU tests in the same browser suite; retained as context showing sensitivity to preceding GPU load.

limitations: CPU filter-only and GPU upload+dispatch+readback measured; no decode, canvas capture, HUD, audio consumer, export or visible presentation.
15 timed frames per mode per invocation; benchmark is a focused harness, not full app acceptance.
A single Procamp island still crosses CPU/GPU for every frame. No multi-filter GPU-resident video rack has been tested.
Only AMD GCN-5 headless Chrome was exercised; no phone or second adapter.
